blocks.text: Double take. Sporting a two-tone finish that pairs a distressed vintage white with aged natural pine color, the Wystfield chairside end table elevates the art of rustic farmhouse living. Enhancing its charm: shelved storage visible through the cabinet door with inset metal grill.

items.label: CHAIR SIDE END TABLE
items.value: The storage space makes this side table the perfect embodiment of beauty and practicality in your home. Distressed with a reclaimed look, it'll entice everyone

items.label: HANDSOMELY CRAFTED
items.value: Table is made of veneers, wood and engineered wood in a distressed finish. Designed with a single door cabinet with metal grills and hardware and a center shelf

items.label: RUSTIC APPEAL
items.value: Between the plank effect styling, visible shelf storage through the metal grills and two-tone finish, this modern table amplifies farmhouse in your home paired with a plant or lamp

items.label: SMALL SPACE SOLUTION
items.value: Measuring 14" W x 17" D x 25" H, this table looks great set by a living room sofa or in narrow spaces such as an entryway or hallway
